children: Mahindra & Mahindra, Hyundai India and auto component suppliers including Sona Comstar are likely to benefit as tighter CAFE 3 norms support faster electrification of India's auto industry, Nomura said.
The brokerage has a 'Buy' rating on Sona Comstar, Uno Minda, Motherson Sumi and Samvardhana Motherson.
"The final notification provides further visibility on the direction of the India auto industry towards electrification," Nomura said in a September 30 report.

The government has notified the Corporate Average Fuel Economy (CAFE) 2027 norms, with no material changes from the July 2026 draft. Compliance will be assessed over two blocks - FY28-30 and FY31-32 - giving automakers greater flexibility around the timing of technology and product launches.

Automakers can trade CAFE credits with other manufacturers, while those falling short can purchase credits from the Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE). The BEE buyout price has been set at Rs 2,500/g CO₂/km for FY28, rising by Rs 500 each year to Rs 4,500/g CO₂/km by FY32.

Electric vehicles continue to receive the highest super-credit under CAFE 3. Battery electric vehicles (BEVs) and range-extended electric vehicles (REEVs) receive a 3.0x credit, plug-in hybrid electric vehicles (PHEVs) and flex-fuel strong hybrids 2.5x, strong hybrids 1.6x and flex-fuel vehicles 1.1x.

Nomura expects EV penetration in passenger vehicles to rise from 7.1% in FY27F to 12.7% in FY30F, while penetration in two-wheelers is expected to increase from 10.1% to 22% over the same period. EV penetration in scooters could reach around 45% by FY30F, from 21% in August 2026.

"Companies with a higher EV salience in their portfolios are likely to gain market share as rising EV penetration and tightening CAFE requirements should increasingly favour OEMs that have already established a faster electrification pathway," Nomura said.

The brokerage expects TMPV and M&M to emerge as key beneficiaries if EV penetration rises faster. Hyundai India could also gain share with its upcoming mass-market EV, expected in January 2027, and its parent Hyundai Motor Company's EV capabilities.

Among suppliers, Nomura expects Sona Comstar to be a key beneficiary given its exposure to electric powertrain components. Uno Minda, Motherson Sumi and Samvardhana Motherson are expected to benefit from higher content opportunities.

title: M&M, Hyundai, Sona Comstar among key CAFE 3 beneficiaries: Nomura
